1s6o7f1.text: Newest, near the point, oldest first: two notches. One. One. Two. Three.

0l4qc67.raw: 'Four, and a star. Four, and a star. Three. Two. One.'
0l4qc67.text: Four, and a star. Four, and a star. Three. Two. One.

1cke072.raw: 'Then one, two, three, cut fresh. Then a place for the next.'
1cke072.text: Then one, two, three, cut fresh. Then a place for the next.

1li2jd9.raw: 'Newest, near the point, oldest first: two notches. Scraped. One. Two. Scraped.'
1li2jd9.text: Newest, near the point, oldest first: two notches. Scraped. One. Two. Scraped.

1iuvg79.raw: 'Four, and a star. Scraped. Three. Two. One.'
1iuvg79.text: Four, and a star. Scraped. Three. Two. One.

1bhpd2j.raw: 'At low, the sea never went like that!! Never!! Scrape them and cut again.'
1bhpd2j.text: At low, the sea never went like that!! Never!! Scrape them and cut again.

1doruxh.raw: 'At the next low, the sea goes out as far as it ever goes. A spring low, greatest of lows!!'
1doruxh.text: At the next low, the sea goes out as far as it ever goes. A spring low, greatest of lows!!

15lfevq.raw: 'At a spring low, the Gleaner walks the whole beach.'
15lfevq.text: At a spring low, the Gleaner walks the whole beach.

1vz1yt0.raw: 'At the first of the ebb, it comes out of the pink shell at the end of the beach.'
1vz1yt0.text: At the first of the ebb, it comes out of the pink shell at the end of the beach.

0011rj0.raw: 'At half ebb, it\'s at the shut one, up the beach. It lifts it, and puts it down.'
0011rj0.text: At half ebb, it's at the shut one, up the beach. It lifts it, and puts it down.

1gcw9wd.raw: 'At dead low, it\'s back at the rows. It sets something in a row.'
1gcw9wd.text: At dead low, it's back at the rows. It sets something in a row.

0qgk6jh.raw: 'At the turn, it goes back into the pink shell and lies down.'
0qgk6jh.text: At the turn, it goes back into the pink shell and lies down.

0cx0lh4.raw: 'At every spring low for three hundred years, that has been the walk. So say the marks.'
0cx0lh4.text: At every spring low for three hundred years, that has been the walk. So say the marks.

0vzccou.raw: 'At the low after the shut one last shed, it was soft. It reached in.'
0vzccou.text: At the low after the shut one last shed, it was soft. It reached in.

0hh5eop.raw: 'At the low after that, it walked with one hand. It\'s walked with one since.'
0hh5eop.text: At the low after that, it walked with one hand. It's walked with one since.

0r2jrfw.raw: 'Sit. That\'s a lot to hear standing up.'
0r2jrfw.text: Sit. That's a lot to hear standing up.

1skssgo.raw: 'At the spring low, the old rooms seal. At the spring high, they open, and seal, and ope-'
1skssgo.text: At the spring low, the old rooms seal. At the spring high, they open, and seal, and ope-

1pa5thm.raw: 'At this tide, you\'ve still time to get out through the siphon. Go round, not back.'
1pa5thm.text: At this tide, you've still time to get out through the siphon. Go round, not back.

1u2yxod.raw: '(The tide table: the menu now shows how far the next low goes, and marks spring lows.)'
1u2yxod.text: (The tide table: the menu now shows how far the next low goes, and marks spring lows.)

0krehu4.raw: '(At low water, footprint marks show on the sand before the stars land.)'
0krehu4.text: (At low water, footprint marks show on the sand before the stars land.)

1q7sv2k.raw: 'Go out through the siphon, by the hole low in the wall.'
1q7sv2k.text: Go out through the siphon, by the hole low in the wall.

1uhiy1k.raw: 'This room is a valve on the left. It seals behind you, and means it.'
1uhiy1k.text: This room is a valve on the left. It seals behind you, and means it.

0u1yw2j.raw: 'Two holes out, this room. This room was my room when I was six, and a fine room.'
0u1yw2j.text: Two holes out, this room. This room was my room when I was six, and a fine room.

1knbdyq.raw: 'This room is still my mother\'s cooking, to the nose, and a valve.'
1knbdyq.text: This room is still my mother's cooking, to the nose, and a valve.

0esp4dc.raw: 'This room is two holes out and a valve. Eggs were kept in it, in rows.'
0esp4dc.text: This room is two holes out and a valve. Eggs were kept in it, in rows.

14z90cl.raw: 'This room is where the pipe bends, ever so gracefully. Two holes out.'
14z90cl.text: This room is where the pipe bends, ever so gracefully. Two holes out.

164lnmn.raw: 'This room is the small one. This room is a valve and a hole and nothing else.'
164lnmn.text: This room is the small one. This room is a valve and a hole and nothing else.

1hrzz2x.raw: `A ring of the siphon opens. ${valvesOpen()} of 6.`
1hrzz2x.text: A ring of the siphon opens. {#1} of 6.

0yprmci.raw: '(Every room you leave seals behind you. Pass through all six valve rooms and finish at the door.)'
0yprmci.text: (Every room you leave seals behind you. Pass through all six valve rooms and finish at the door.)

1linx0p.raw: 'This room is sealed now. This room reopens at the next high water, without fail.'
1linx0p.text: This room is sealed now. This room reopens at the next high water, without fail.

07mgyqa.raw: 'This room is on the far side of the door. This room is waiting for you, with great patience.'
07mgyqa.text: This room is on the far side of the door. This room is waiting for you, with great patience.

0t5im9w.raw: 'Ha. This is a sitting job. My favorite kind.'
0t5im9w.text: Ha. This is a sitting job. My favorite kind.

1onu7zq.raw: 'I\'ll sit. Can see you through the door from here. That\'s plenty.'
1onu7zq.text: I'll sit. Can see you through the door from here. That's plenty.

1iv4prf.raw: 'Sit there, where I can see you through the window.'
1iv4prf.text: Sit there, where I can see you through the window.

132m5p1.raw: 'Up. And down. Up. And down. My knees have opinions about the big low.'
132m5p1.text: Up. And down. Up. And down. My knees have opinions about the big low.

15p00n5.raw: 'Inside, every climber is climbing at once. The stair is full. (someone is going down the up side)'
15p00n5.text: Inside, every climber is climbing at once. The stair is full. (someone is going down the up side)

1yr3wbl.raw: 'A whole wreck, lying on its side on sand nobody here has seen dry.'
1yr3wbl.text: A whole wreck, lying on its side on sand nobody here has seen dry.

145kvyd.raw: 'Weed lies flat over it. Something in the hold is breathing slowly.'
145kvyd.text: Weed lies flat over it. Something in the hold is breathing slowly.

1udazog.raw: 'The anchor stone. The sea is so far out that its hole is full of stars.'
1udazog.text: The anchor stone. The sea is so far out that its hole is full of stars.

05s020g.raw: 'Far up the beach, a hand lifts the Volute out of the sand.'
05s020g.text: Far up the beach, a hand lifts the Volute out of the sand.

1c0ufx8.raw: 'The hand holds the Volute up to where an ear would be.'
1c0ufx8.text: The hand holds the Volute up to where an ear would be.

1cfdbny.raw: 'Follow the footprints east, along the upper beach.'
1cfdbny.text: Follow the footprints east, along the upper beach.

1ec6rfv.raw: 'Cutting dune grass for thatch. I go round the labels. Feels rude to cut a label.'
1ec6rfv.text: Cutting dune grass for thatch. I go round the labels. Feels rude to cut a label.

0q27k97.raw: 'Big low! Once a year you get to run right behind the stars! Come on, come on!'
0q27k97.text: Big low! Once a year you get to run right behind the stars! Come on, come on!

15aiwox.text: Aw. Fine, you win. Now run!

01e9nio.raw: 'I turn the jellies over so they don\'t dry out. Do they say thanks? They do not.'
01e9nio.text: I turn the jellies over so they don't dry out. Do they say thanks? They do not.

02t5sdt.raw: 'Yeah, they\'re not gonna thank you either.'
02t5sdt.text: Yeah, they're not gonna thank you either.

1bnusyo.raw: 'A label stuck in a dune, driftwood, pressed with big letters that lean and grow toward the end.'
1bnusyo.text: A label stuck in a dune, driftwood, pressed with big letters that lean and grow toward the end.

0x19iln.raw: 'A label on a tall post, its top cut to point upward.'
0x19iln.text: A label on a tall post, its top cut to point upward.

1wk843e.raw: 'A label lying on its side where the wind blew it over. Nobody has stood it back up.'
1wk843e.text: A label lying on its side where the wind blew it over. Nobody has stood it back up.

0qadyw6.raw: 'A label half buried, the letters smaller and neater, very old.'
0qadyw6.text: A label half buried, the letters smaller and neater, very old.

029i6tb.raw: 'A label in the marram, with the grass grown up round it.'
029i6tb.text: A label in the marram, with the grass grown up round it.

0mzyzcl.raw: 'A label leaning on another label. (the other one leans back)'
0mzyzcl.text: A label leaning on another label. (the other one leans back)

1cky0y6.raw: 'A label with a crab living under it. The crab comes out, sees Ouro, and goes back in.'
1cky0y6.text: A label with a crab living under it. The crab comes out, sees Ouro, and goes back in.

175ip5x.raw: 'A label stuck in the sand in no order with the others.'
175ip5x.text: A label stuck in the sand in no order with the others.

1h6hynr.raw: 'A label with sand drifted up to the K.'
1h6hynr.text: A label with sand drifted up to the K.

1ebpref.raw: 'A new label. The letters are the biggest yet.'
1ebpref.text: A new label. The letters are the biggest yet.

1ve9gbm.raw: 'A label in the wet sand, leaning toward the sea.'
1ve9gbm.text: A label in the wet sand, leaning toward the sea.

0hklsmg.raw: 'A label at the edge of the water. Each small wave comes up to it and goes back.'
0hklsmg.text: A label at the edge of the water. Each small wave comes up to it and goes back.

0gtzrk4.raw: 'A label. Something has scratched under the letters, small: "not this one".'
0gtzrk4.text: A label. Something has scratched under the letters, small: "not this one".

0ozb8mz.raw: 'Dug into the lee of a dune, out of the wind, a nautilus horn and a notion.'
0ozb8mz.text: Dug into the lee of a dune, out of the wind, a nautilus horn and a notion.

0ezjtqx.raw: 'Low water. Look at all that sand. Nothing\'s coming to take any of it.'
0ezjtqx.text: Low water. Look at all that sand. Nothing's coming to take any of it.

1acmx3v.raw: 'High water. KEEP THE SEA\'s under the sea now. Only one out here that got what it asked for.'
1acmx3v.text: High water. KEEP THE SEA's under the sea now. Only one out here that got what it asked for.

04g4vvj.raw: 'I read \'em, that\'s all I do. First word\'s always KEEP. After THE it gets tricky.'
04g4vvj.text: I read 'em, that's all I do. First word's always KEEP. After THE it gets tricky.

0vcpcpb.raw: 'Old ones are neat and small. New ones are huge. Hurts my neck, honestly.'
0vcpcpb.text: Old ones are neat and small. New ones are huge. Hurts my neck, honestly.

0r412ip.raw: 'Got a shell for catching, if you want it. Stars land in the same holes here every year. Same holes!'
0r412ip.text: Got a shell for catching, if you want it. Stars land in the same holes here every year. Same holes!

0720y75.raw: '(Starfall on the Long Strand: stars fall only in the footprint columns. Learn the order.)'
0720y75.text: (Starfall on the Long Strand: stars fall only in the footprint columns. Learn the order.)

0h0yb4h.raw: `${score}! Clean night. I'll write that on a label. A small one, not like theirs.`
0h0yb4h.text: {score}! Clean night. I'll write that on a label. A small one, not like theirs.

0dgb0at.raw: `${score}. Watch the holes. They always pick the same holes.`
0dgb0at.text: {score}. Watch the holes. They always pick the same holes.

19b7dpx.raw: 'Nope. Not coming out. Not at dead low, and not for just anybody.'
19b7dpx.text: Nope. Not coming out. Not at dead low, and not for just anybody.

0fu0jes.raw: 'I never stay in the same shell. Never skip past one, either. Always next door.'
0fu0jes.text: I never stay in the same shell. Never skip past one, either. Always next door.

14b0z1l.raw: 'And I don\'t grab a shell I haven\'t had my ear on first.'
14b0z1l.text: And I don't grab a shell I haven't had my ear on first.

1fiaiwn.raw: '(Put your ear to a shell to listen. An empty shell plays with notes missing.)'
1fiaiwn.text: (Put your ear to a shell to listen. An empty shell plays with notes missing.)

0sr6yz8.raw: '(A shell with someone moving in it plays with footsteps in it.)'
0sr6yz8.text: (A shell with someone moving in it plays with footsteps in it.)

0s0pa76.raw: 'Huh. Don\'t usually lose that one. Don\'t mind, though. Much.'
0s0pa76.text: Huh. Don't usually lose that one. Don't mind, though. Much.

1e1k58d.raw: 'Rules, if you\'re sticking round. No labeled ones. No standing up at dead low.'
1e1k58d.text: Rules, if you're sticking round. No labeled ones. No standing up at dead low.

0j7wr6c.raw: 'And I never look up at it. Don\'t need to. You learn the feet, you don\'t forget the feet.'
0j7wr6c.text: And I never look up at it. Don't need to. You learn the feet, you don't forget the feet.

1pisapb.raw: 'Look at the big square in the middle of the Tray.'
1pisapb.text: Look at the big square in the middle of the Tray.

0wposod.raw: 'The posts are white and round on top. They are as tall as the posts at the corners of the Margin.'
0wposod.text: The posts are white and round on top. They are as tall as the posts at the corners of the Margin.

0uergi9.raw: 'I stay off the big square. Never seen a thing in it. Not once.'
0uergi9.text: I stay off the big square. Never seen a thing in it. Not once.

1cwa69k.raw: 'Listened down every row. Once. Not doing it twice. Not one whole tune in the lot.'
1cwa69k.text: Listened down every row. Once. Not doing it twice. Not one whole tune in the lot.

0e3we77.raw: 'Never heard one play the whole thing. Except yours, way up the beach.'
0e3we77.text: Never heard one play the whole thing. Except yours, way up the beach.

0nvdxcm.text: Stand by the big empty square.

0ijqyim.raw: 'Labeled. I wouldn\'t. Wouldn\'t stop you, though.'
0ijqyim.text: Labeled. I wouldn't. Wouldn't stop you, though.

1h6wddx.raw: 'Ouro gets Gran\'s boot, full of sand seventy years old.'
1h6wddx.text: Ouro gets Gran's boot, full of sand seventy years old.

0dpzxre.raw: 'The gray shell is drawn all over with fractures. In the fractures are the shapes of towns.'
0dpzxre.text: The gray shell is drawn all over with fractures. In the fractures are the shapes of towns.

0q459qh.raw: '(The old Apex. Cinch would want to see it, when the sea has been in.)'
0q459qh.text: (The old Apex. Cinch would want to see it, when the sea has been in.)

05er1jh.raw: '(At dead low the Gleaner works in the Tray. Its feet are dangerous. Keep out of the rows it is in.)'
05er1jh.text: (At dead low the Gleaner works in the Tray. Its feet are dangerous. Keep out of the rows it is in.)

062bu9x.raw: 'Something moves in one of the small shells at the north edge of the Tray.'
062bu9x.text: Something moves in one of the small shells at the north edge of the Tray.

02ciw0v.raw: '312 squares. Still 1 empty. 1 of us sat by it all night, and it wasn\'t me.'
02ciw0v.text: 312 squares. Still 1 empty. 1 of us sat by it all night, and it wasn't me.

0x6c1ch.raw: 'Counted 312 squares. Twice. 1 empty. The big 1, in the middle.'
0x6c1ch.text: Counted 312 squares. Twice. 1 empty. The big 1, in the middle.

14fjpzl.raw: 'It picked up 40 in a row and put every one back in order. Showoff.'
14fjpzl.text: It picked up 40 in a row and put every one back in order. Showoff.

0ecerwf.raw: 'No labels. Don\'t need \'em. Don\'t need anybody doing it for me, either.'
0ecerwf.text: No labels. Don't need 'em. Don't need anybody doing it for me, either.

0g0xeml.raw: 'Here. I don\'t keep keys I can\'t use. Opens the last room in the top one.'
0g0xeml.text: Here. I don't keep keys I can't use. Opens the last room in the top one.

0i98goo.raw: 'No more lying flat at low. Don\'t miss it. Well. My elbows don\'t.'
0i98goo.text: No more lying flat at low. Don't miss it. Well. My elbows don't.

0bdsx1x.raw: 'Don\'t bother pulling it. I\'ve tried. They don\'t stay off.'
0bdsx1x.text: Don't bother pulling it. I've tried. They don't stay off.

1r6uy3y.raw: 'Mine never stand still at low. Never. You saw why.'
1r6uy3y.text: Mine never stand still at low. Never. You saw why.

090vsy6.raw: 'Can\'t carry it flat, I don\'t keep it. That\'s the whole rule.'
090vsy6.text: Can't carry it flat, I don't keep it. That's the whole rule.

09nyqys.raw: 'Told you. No labeled ones. No standing up at dead low.'
09nyqys.text: Told you. No labeled ones. No standing up at dead low.

0vgheyo.raw: 'Big square\'s in the middle. Go look. I\'m not going near it.'
0vgheyo.text: Big square's in the middle. Go look. I'm not going near it.

1y7efc5.raw: 'Don\'t live in the rows. Don\'t live far off, either. This way.'
1y7efc5.text: Don't live in the rows. Don't live far off, either. This way.

1vaccv6.raw: 'Wouldn\'t put my door anywhere its feet don\'t come. Nobody looks where they step.'
1vaccv6.text: Wouldn't put my door anywhere its feet don't come. Nobody looks where they step.

1t5i7tv.raw: 'Sit. Wade, huh. That\'s a name for somebody small.'
1t5i7tv.text: Sit. Wade, huh. That's a name for somebody small.

0x5onvy.raw: 'Still sitting with that one. Room here if you want to sit with it too.'
0x5onvy.text: Still sitting with that one. Room here if you want to sit with it too.

00fezol.raw: 'The hand lifts them both, high, up beside the dark where an ear would be.'
00fezol.text: The hand lifts them both, high, up beside the dark where an ear would be.

0srj79w.raw: '(Small Gran is marked. The label goes where she goes.)'
0srj79w.text: (Small Gran is marked. The label goes where she goes.)

01rj65c.raw: `(${lifted?.name} is marked. The label goes where it goes.)`
01rj65c.text: ({#1} is marked. The label goes where it goes.)

1sp9bt4.raw: 'Sit. They let me out at the high. Sent soup.'
1sp9bt4.text: Sit. They let me out at the high. Sent soup.

0r1vkfc.raw: 'Sit here by me. You can see the pink one from here, down the beach.'
0r1vkfc.text: Sit here by me. You can see the pink one from here, down the beach.

1s0t8i1.raw: 'Down the beach, something very large lies curled in the mouth of the great pink shell.'
1s0t8i1.text: Down the beach, something very large lies curled in the mouth of the great pink shell.

0xqhhpx.raw: 'Sit and watch it a while. Same thing, every time.'
0xqhhpx.text: Sit and watch it a while. Same thing, every time.

0f8trjd.raw: 'Seen that before. Left one at a post myself. Did the same thing every day.'
0f8trjd.text: Seen that before. Left one at a post myself. Did the same thing every day.

0p0mliy.raw: 'From here it looks like a cast. Somebody\'s. Somebody big.'
0p0mliy.text: From here it looks like a cast. Somebody's. Somebody big.

0jbyemp.raw: 'Sit with that one a while. I would.'
0jbyemp.text: Sit with that one a while. I would.

1le2bxx.raw: 'From down here we look alike. Got my nose, see.'
1le2bxx.text: From down here we look alike. Got my nose, see.

03x0xbd.raw: 'Letters wait at the Sand Dollar post. The pink shell lies at the east end of the beach.'
03x0xbd.text: Letters wait at the Sand Dollar post. The pink shell lies at the east end of the beach.

06ajpzg.raw: `One of the Mudlark's own labels, scratched small in a different hand: "${s}".`
06ajpzg.text: One of the Mudlark's own labels, scratched small in a different hand: "{s}".

0iio6ma.raw: '(The Gleaner\'s feet come down in the yard in the same round of six steps.)'
0iio6ma.text: (The Gleaner's feet come down in the yard in the same round of six steps.)

15dkcs9.raw: '(With the tide table, a mark shows where the next foot lands.)'
15dkcs9.text: (With the tide table, a mark shows where the next foot lands.)

06pdgfs.raw: 'Don\'t fight fair. Don\'t fight long. Get down here.'
06pdgfs.text: Don't fight fair. Don't fight long. Get down here.

06y72q1.raw: 'Keep it. Never keep what I win anyway.'
06y72q1.text: Keep it. Never keep what I win anyway.

0n0sr7e.raw: 'There. Don\'t give these out much. Don\'t have much to give.'
0n0sr7e.text: There. Don't give these out much. Don't have much to give.

1wyob4u.raw: 'Go on, then. I don\'t keep anything I can\'t carry flat.'
1wyob4u.text: Go on, then. I don't keep anything I can't carry flat.

0o5dj1l.text: Stand by the big empty square.

0x2dezb.text: Listen at the big empty square.

0d2lzvb.raw: 'Not coming out to the gate. I\'ll wait at the door. Mind the feet.'
0d2lzvb.text: Not coming out to the gate. I'll wait at the door. Mind the feet.

0358nfp.raw: 'Back again? I don\'t keep anything I can\'t carry flat. You included.'
0358nfp.text: Back again? I don't keep anything I can't carry flat. You included.

13w4s5u.raw: 'In the square the ground is fractured all over.'
13w4s5u.text: In the square the ground is fractured all over.

0gcmixd.raw: 'In the middle is a shell-shaped hollow, and nothing in it.'
0gcmixd.text: In the middle is a shell-shaped hollow, and nothing in it.

133n2af.raw: 'On a kitchen wall, children\'s heights scratched in the plaster.'
133n2af.text: On a kitchen wall, children's heights scratched in the plaster.

10dwipf.raw: 'The top mark is a little higher than the rest.'
10dwipf.text: The top mark is a little higher than the rest.

1ljl06j.raw: 'Down the well, on a ledge above the dry bottom, a nautilus horn.'
1ljl06j.text: Down the well, on a ledge above the dry bottom, a nautilus horn.

0flui5e.raw: 'In the child\'s room, in a box under the bed, five grains of nacre.'
0flui5e.text: In the child's room, in a box under the bed, five grains of nacre.

171qgy3.raw: 'A cart with its shafts down. Nothing is between the shafts.'
171qgy3.text: A cart with its shafts down. Nothing is between the shafts.

1yf3bri.raw: 'A row of washing over a wall, dry for years. It does not move.'
1yf3bri.text: A row of washing over a wall, dry for years. It does not move.

0lbti28.raw: 'A door with a lock. Every other door here opens for stillness. This one wants a key.'
0lbti28.text: A door with a lock. Every other door here opens for stillness. This one wants a key.

1tqabxp.raw: '(Doors here open only when nothing moves near them.)'
1tqabxp.text: (Doors here open only when nothing moves near them.)

0b6gpt7.raw: 'The flat round place, fractured all over. Through the fractures, far below, the Tray\'s rows.'
0b6gpt7.text: The flat round place, fractured all over. Through the fractures, far below, the Tray's rows.

0g805z5.raw: 'Sit. That\'s me, there. Still at it.'
0g805z5.text: Sit. That's me, there. Still at it.

1tp884p.raw: 'There. Both of us sitting. Only took forty years.'
1tp884p.text: There. Both of us sitting. Only took forty years.

1rhqkjj.raw: 'Sit and watch me a while. Funny. Never stops, does it.'
1rhqkjj.text: Sit and watch me a while. Funny. Never stops, does it.

1ew7x78.raw: 'Sit down by me, then. You\'ve stood long enough.'
1ew7x78.text: Sit down by me, then. You've stood long enough.

0eocihh.raw: 'Four. W, A, D, E. Still four. Only count I\'ve ever been sure of.'
0eocihh.text: Four. W, A, D, E. Still four. Only count I've ever been sure of.

0djz2uj.raw: 'Four. Letters, I think, in the shine on the far knuckle. Can\'t read backward, me.'
0djz2uj.text: Four. Letters, I think, in the shine on the far knuckle. Can't read backward, me.

0db3j2h.raw: 'One. Star, that\'s what it takes. Maybe two. Stand on the far knuckle at night and wait.'
0db3j2h.text: One. Star, that's what it takes. Maybe two. Stand on the far knuckle at night and wait.

1mjzk5b.raw: 'There. Violet. I\'m Druse. I crack geodes and I\'m never wrong about the inside.'
1mjzk5b.text: There. Violet. I'm Druse. I crack geodes and I'm never wrong about the inside.

1jr0tf2.raw: 'Inside your pack there\'s no setter\'s board. Bezel in Rib has spares. Ask.'
1jr0tf2.text: Inside your pack there's no setter's board. Bezel in Rib has spares. Ask.

0559p3j.raw: 'Inside your pack there\'s a setter\'s board with sketches on it. Show me what you\'ve set.'
0559p3j.text: Inside your pack there's a setter's board with sketches on it. Show me what you've set.

1qo4yup.raw: 'Still no board in there. Bezel, in Rib. Spares.'
1qo4yup.text: Still no board in there. Bezel, in Rib. Spares.

0h1m8xo.raw: 'All twelve set. Inside the crater fields, the geode just opened. I heard it from here.'
0h1m8xo.text: All twelve set. Inside the crater fields, the geode just opened. I heard it from here.

1b03nah.raw: 'The east crater, north of Fall. Its south rim. Bring something soft for your ears.'
1b03nah.text: The east crater, north of Fall. Its south rim. Bring something soft for your ears.

0vg7y0q.raw: 'Inside the Hollow the whorl is still counting. It wants every sketch, the Shellwrights\' too.'
0vg7y0q.text: Inside the Hollow the whorl is still counting. It wants every sketch, the Shellwrights' too.

0vw753u.raw: `${n} set. Inside your head there's a machine-shaped room now. Good. I need it.`
0vw753u.text: {n} set. Inside your head there's a machine-shaped room now. Good. I need it.

0phbcsa.raw: 'Inside the crater fields north of Fall there\'s a geode as big as Rib. Nobody\'s opened it.'
0phbcsa.text: Inside the crater fields north of Fall there's a geode as big as Rib. Nobody's opened it.

1qreq0y.raw: 'Its door is a seam in the east crater, a lock of twelve settings. Set all 12 sketches and it opens.'
1qreq0y.text: Its door is a seam in the east crater, a lock of twelve settings. Set all 12 sketches and it opens.

1i8chyp.raw: 'Inside it there\'s a whorl strung like a necklace. I\'ve never seen it. It\'s there, though.'
1i8chyp.text: Inside it there's a whorl strung like a necklace. I've never seen it. It's there, though.

145u3vu.raw: `${n} of 12. Inside the geode the whorl is counting along with you.`
145u3vu.text: {n} of 12. Inside the geode the whorl is counting along with you.

1q5nnhe.raw: 'Inside that board there\'s not a scratch. Run something. Break something.'
1q5nnhe.text: Inside that board there's not a scratch. Run something. Break something.

0j9a7o0.raw: `${runs} runs. Inside each one there's a little click where it works or doesn't.`
0j9a7o0.text: {runs} runs. Inside each one there's a little click where it works or doesn't.

15cw5hk.raw: `${runs} runs. Inside that number there are a lot of stones on the floor.`
15cw5hk.text: {runs} runs. Inside that number there are a lot of stones on the floor.

071vgku.raw: `${runs} runs! Inside you there's a setter. Bezel will be cross.`
071vgku.text: {runs} runs! Inside you there's a setter. Bezel will be cross.

153yrqf.raw: `(The seam in the rim chimes once for each Setting puzzle set: ${n} of 12.)`
153yrqf.text: (The seam in the rim chimes once for each Setting puzzle set: {n} of 12.)

12zwdqd.raw: '(The socket rings flat. It wants the stones it shows, each on its own mark.)'
12zwdqd.text: (The socket rings flat. It wants the stones it shows, each on its own mark.)

1l4jy96.raw: `(Carcanet does not stir. ${n} of its ${ALL_PUZZLES.length} settings ring. Set every sketch, the bought ones too.)`
1l4jy96.text: (Carcanet does not stir. {n} of its {ALL_PUZZLES.length} settings ring. Set every sketch, the bought ones too.)

06x7wd3.raw: '(Carcanet sets its Stones in the order of its Tape. Write the Tape in Setting, under its name.)'
06x7wd3.text: (Carcanet sets its Stones in the order of its Tape. Write the Tape in Setting, under its name.)

0w79lkq.raw: 'A whorl is a creature that fights for you. Your team is the whorls you take with you. A team can have 4 whorls.'
0w79lkq.text: A whorl is a creature that fights for you. Your team is the whorls you take with you. A team can have 4 whorls.

1vudnji.raw: 'The first whorl in your team is your lead. Your lead walks with you. It is the first one out in a battle.'
1vudnji.text: The first whorl in your team is your lead. Your lead walks with you. It is the first one out in a battle.

1qkoa09.raw: 'One whorl fights at a time. It is your out whorl. The others wait in reserve.'
1qkoa09.text: One whorl fights at a time. It is your out whorl. The others wait in reserve.

0inh1l7.raw: 'Pick Switch in a battle to send out a whorl from reserve. A switch is quick. The whorl you send out waits less than after an Attack. More CHA makes its wait even shorter.'
0inh1l7.text: Pick Switch in a battle to send out a whorl from reserve. A switch is quick. The whorl you send out waits less than after an Attack. More CHA makes its wait even shorter.

1oqaeg9.raw: 'A whorl that is rooted or taunted cannot switch out.'
1oqaeg9.text: A whorl that is rooted or taunted cannot switch out.

0ysdkxq.raw: 'A whorl with 0 HP is knocked out. The game also says it is down, or calls it a KO. It cannot fight again in that battle. Then you pick the next whorl to send out.'
0ysdkxq.text: A whorl with 0 HP is knocked out. The game also says it is down, or calls it a KO. It cannot fight again in that battle. Then you pick the next whorl to send out.

0my99bz.raw: 'Every battle starts with full HP. So a knocked out whorl is fine when the battle is over.'
0my99bz.text: Every battle starts with full HP. So a knocked out whorl is fine when the battle is over.

1jjalxt.raw: 'If your whole team is down, you lose the battle. You drop 20% of your cowries. Then you walk back to the last grotto you used. A grotto is the shop in each town.'
1jjalxt.text: If your whole team is down, you lose the battle. You drop 20% of your cowries. Then you walk back to the last grotto you used. A grotto is the shop in each town.

1sm686s.raw: 'When your team is full, new whorls go to the Midden. You can reach the Midden at any grotto. There you can swap whorls in and out of your team.'
1sm686s.text: When your team is full, new whorls go to the Midden. You can reach the Midden at any grotto. There you can swap whorls in and out of your team.

1lnp2ob.raw: 'To pick a new lead, press X for the menu. Pick Team, then pick a whorl. Then pick Make lead.'
1lnp2ob.text: To pick a new lead, press X for the menu. Pick Team, then pick a whorl. Then pick Make lead.

1gyh2da.raw: 'Each whorl has seven stats. A stat is a number. It tells you how good the whorl is at one thing.'
1gyh2da.text: Each whorl has seven stats. A stat is a number. It tells you how good the whorl is at one thing.

018cbom.raw: 'HP is health. A whorl with 0 HP is knocked out. Max HP is the most HP it can have.'
018cbom.text: HP is health. A whorl with 0 HP is knocked out. Max HP is the most HP it can have.

0xxi4t5.raw: 'ATK is the power of physical hits.'
0xxi4t5.text: ATK is the power of physical hits.

1qt3jfs.raw: 'MGK is the power of magic hits.'
1qt3jfs.text: MGK is the power of magic hits.

1vxls2q.text: DEF makes physical hits do less.

0mnhthv.text: RES makes magic hits do less.

040vnj4.raw: 'AGI is speed. A whorl with more AGI gets more turns.'
040vnj4.text: AGI is speed. A whorl with more AGI gets more turns.

02luagw.raw: 'CHA helps a horn catch a whorl. A whorl with more CHA waits less after a Switch. Some moves use CHA too.'
02luagw.text: CHA helps a horn catch a whorl. A whorl with more CHA waits less after a Switch. Some moves use CHA too.

0pwh054.raw: 'Each species has its own strengths. One species may have more ATK. Another may have more DEF. Species are also different in their moves, habits, and types.'
0pwh054.text: Each species has its own strengths. One species may have more ATK. Another may have more DEF. Species are also different in their moves, habits, and types.

1pcak1s.raw: 'Every species gets the same number of stat points. Each species puts them in different places. So a fast species has less DEF, and a tough species gets fewer turns. A conjoined whorl gets half its points from each of the two old whorls.'
1pcak1s.text: Every species gets the same number of stat points. Each species puts them in different places. So a fast species has less DEF, and a tough species gets fewer turns. A conjoined whorl gets half its points from each of the two old whorls.

10qw4ds.raw: 'This picture shows the stats of your lead. Stats go up when a whorl gains a level. Things you find later can raise them a little more.'
10qw4ds.text: This picture shows the stats of your lead. Stats go up when a whorl gains a level. Things you find later can raise them a little more.

0ob984x.raw: 'Many texts use the sign %. It means out of 100. 50% is half. 25% is one quarter. 10% is one tenth.'
0ob984x.text: Many texts use the sign %. It means out of 100. 50% is half. 25% is one quarter. 10% is one tenth.

19dy71e.raw: 'Each whorl has a plain Attack. It is physical or magic. A physical Attack uses ATK. A magic Attack uses MGK.'
19dy71e.text: Each whorl has a plain Attack. It is physical or magic. A physical Attack uses ATK. A magic Attack uses MGK.

1ee5vmn.raw: 'A move\'s text tells you which stat it uses. Hits for 110% ATK is a physical hit. Hits for 90% MGK is a magic hit.'
1ee5vmn.text: A move's text tells you which stat it uses. Hits for 110% ATK is a physical hit. Hits for 90% MGK is a magic hit.

1iwboyb.raw: 'DEF and RES make a hit smaller. Say a hit has 100 power. It does 70 damage to a whorl with 42 DEF. It does 50 damage to a whorl with 100 DEF.'
1iwboyb.text: DEF and RES make a hit smaller. Say a hit has 100 power. It does 70 damage to a whorl with 42 DEF. It does 50 damage to a whorl with 100 DEF.

17cp80e.raw: 'So DEF helps most against physical whorls. RES helps most against magic whorls.'
17cp80e.text: So DEF helps most against physical whorls. RES helps most against magic whorls.

1ed1xsh.raw: 'To see a whorl\'s stats, press X. Pick Team, then the whorl, then Look. The Stats tab shows them.'
1ed1xsh.text: To see a whorl's stats, press X. Pick Team, then the whorl, then Look. The Stats tab shows them.

0rwpw6c.raw: 'In a battle, a whorl waits after it acts. AGI makes the wait shorter. So a fast whorl gets more turns.'
0rwpw6c.text: In a battle, a whorl waits after it acts. AGI makes the wait shorter. So a fast whorl gets more turns.

0ul3im3.raw: 'Here is an example. Your whorl has 69 AGI. The foe has 51 AGI. Over the whole battle, your whorl gets about 9 turns for every 8 the foe gets.'
0ul3im3.text: Here is an example. Your whorl has 69 AGI. The foe has 51 AGI. Over the whole battle, your whorl gets about 9 turns for every 8 the foe gets.

0meddh9.raw: 'Most of the time, your turn and the foe\'s turn come close together. Then you both pick at the same time. You do not see the foe\'s pick. The foe does not see yours.'
0meddh9.text: Most of the time, your turn and the foe's turn come close together. Then you both pick at the same time. You do not see the foe's pick. The foe does not see yours.

1yajj3n.raw: 'Then the two actions happen in order. The whorl whose turn comes first goes first. The top line tells you who goes first.'
1yajj3n.text: Then the two actions happen in order. The whorl whose turn comes first goes first. The top line tells you who goes first.

06vdcik.raw: 'Guard and Switch always go first. A Quick move goes next. A Late move waits until the foe has moved.'
06vdcik.text: Guard and Switch always go first. A Quick move goes next. A Late move waits until the foe has moved.

0p9ry30.raw: 'So try to guess what the foe will do. If a big hit is coming, Guard. If the foe will Guard, use a dash. If the foe will use a TIDE move, switch to a whorl that takes less from it.'
0p9ry30.text: So try to guess what the foe will do. If a big hit is coming, Guard. If the foe will Guard, use a dash. If the foe will use a TIDE move, switch to a whorl that takes less from it.

1higm7a.raw: 'Sometimes one turn comes much sooner than the other. Then that side picks alone and moves. So a fast whorl can move twice before a slow one moves once. The top line tells you when this will happen.'
1higm7a.text: Sometimes one turn comes much sooner than the other. Then that side picks alone and moves. So a fast whorl can move twice before a slow one moves once. The top line tells you when this will happen.

0v4s7qn.raw: 'Some actions have a short wait. A whorl waits 80% as long after a Guard as after an Attack. The whorl you switch in waits about 70% as long. More CHA makes that wait shorter. The Switch list shows the wait for each whorl.'
0v4s7qn.text: Some actions have a short wait. A whorl waits 80% as long after a Guard as after an Attack. The whorl you switch in waits about 70% as long. More CHA makes that wait shorter. The Switch list shows the wait for each whorl.

1nf4u4c.raw: 'Slow 1 pushes the whorl\'s next turn back. It waits 30% of a turn more. Slow 2 does this for its next 2 turns.'
1nf4u4c.text: Slow 1 pushes the whorl's next turn back. It waits 30% of a turn more. Slow 2 does this for its next 2 turns.

0er3wxe.raw: 'Haste works the other way. Each turn comes 30% of a turn sooner.'
0er3wxe.text: Haste works the other way. Each turn comes 30% of a turn sooner.

02w5fj1.raw: 'A slowed foe often goes last. Slow it twice, and you may get a turn of your own.'
02w5fj1.text: A slowed foe often goes last. Slow it twice, and you may get a turn of your own.

0wfzr22.raw: 'Some texts say its next turn comes 40% sooner. This means the whorl waits less before it moves again. The wait gets about 40% shorter.'
0wfzr22.text: Some texts say its next turn comes 40% sooner. This means the whorl waits less before it moves again. The wait gets about 40% shorter.

0of2wqb.raw: 'Some moves change the whole field for a few rounds. Sea Fog and High Tide are two of them. The field works on both sides, so it can help the foe too.'
0of2wqb.text: Some moves change the whole field for a few rounds. Sea Fog and High Tide are two of them. The field works on both sides, so it can help the foe too.

1gtjpoh.raw: 'A wind-up is a move that lands later. A ! shows over a whorl while it winds up. The top line tells you how many moves you get first.'
1gtjpoh.text: A wind-up is a move that lands later. A ! shows over a whorl while it winds up. The top line tells you how many moves you get first.

14gwfcn.raw: 'You can stop a foe\'s wind-up. Stun, Silence, Sleep, or Taunt cuts it off. So does forcing the foe out.'
14gwfcn.text: You can stop a foe's wind-up. Stun, Silence, Sleep, or Taunt cuts it off. So does forcing the foe out.

1oq1pi2.raw: 'You can also switch to a whorl that takes less from the move. An Unstoppable wind-up cannot be cut off.'
1oq1pi2.text: You can also switch to a whorl that takes less from the move. An Unstoppable wind-up cannot be cut off.

1k720u6.raw: 'A round is one turn for each side. The field counts rounds. So does a very long battle.'
1k720u6.text: A round is one turn for each side. The field counts rounds. So does a very long battle.

0scsx4i.raw: 'On your turn, you pick one action. You can Attack, use a move, Guard, or Switch.'
0scsx4i.text: On your turn, you pick one action. You can Attack, use a move, Guard, or Switch.

1npi0x2.raw: 'Attack is your whorl\'s plain hit. You can use it every turn. It never runs out. An Attack has no type, so it hits every type the same.'
1npi0x2.text: Attack is your whorl's plain hit. You can use it every turn. It never runs out. An Attack has no type, so it hits every type the same.

0pn7mh4.raw: 'Some Attacks hit more than once. A habit that works after an Attack still works once for the whole Attack. A habit that says hits works on each hit.'
0pn7mh4.text: Some Attacks hit more than once. A habit that works after an Attack still works once for the whole Attack. A habit that says hits works on each hit.

09lkib6.raw: 'Each whorl has four moves. A move hits harder, or it does something special. Before you pick a move, look at it. Its text tells you what it does.'
09lkib6.text: Each whorl has four moves. A move hits harder, or it does something special. Before you pick a move, look at it. Its text tells you what it does.

0wnb13w.raw: 'The text is short. Hits for 110% ATK means a hit with 1.1 times the whorl\'s ATK. Slow 1 means the foe is slowed for 1 turn.'
0wnb13w.text: The text is short. Hits for 110% ATK means a hit with 1.1 times the whorl's ATK. Slow 1 means the foe is slowed for 1 turn.

0jmf5wv.raw: 'After you use a move, it has to rest. The rest is its cooldown. The menu shows how many turns are left.'
0jmf5wv.text: After you use a move, it has to rest. The rest is its cooldown. The menu shows how many turns are left.

11qui76.raw: 'Here is an example. Flatten has a cooldown of 3. Squall uses Flatten. Then Flatten rests for Squall\'s next 3 turns. On the 4th turn, it is ready again.'
11qui76.text: Here is an example. Flatten has a cooldown of 3. Squall uses Flatten. Then Flatten rests for Squall's next 3 turns. On the 4th turn, it is ready again.

0m2r4c3.raw: 'A cooldown counts your side\'s turns. It keeps going down while the whorl waits in reserve.'
0m2r4c3.text: A cooldown counts your side's turns. It keeps going down while the whorl waits in reserve.

1titfc5.raw: 'A move of the whorl\'s own type hits 20% harder. Squall is a TIDE whorl. So its TIDE moves hit 20% harder.'
1titfc5.text: A move of the whorl's own type hits 20% harder. Squall is a TIDE whorl. So its TIDE moves hit 20% harder.

1md25am.raw: 'Some moves splash. The out foe takes the full hit. Each foe in reserve takes a part of it too. The move says how big a part.'
1md25am.text: Some moves splash. The out foe takes the full hit. Each foe in reserve takes a part of it too. The move says how big a part.

1til1cf.raw: 'Splash 35% means each foe in reserve takes 35% of the hit. A small splash is a spray. Splash 100% hits the whole team the same.'
1til1cf.text: Splash 35% means each foe in reserve takes 35% of the hit. A small splash is a spray. Splash 100% hits the whole team the same.

0guosgw.raw: 'Guard cuts the damage your whorl takes in half. It lasts until your whorl\'s next turn. A Guard always goes first in a round.'
0guosgw.text: Guard cuts the damage your whorl takes in half. It lasts until your whorl's next turn. A Guard always goes first in a round.

1kj0a52.raw: 'A Guard stops more of a projectile. It does not stop a dash at all.'
1kj0a52.text: A Guard stops more of a projectile. It does not stop a dash at all.

1asdj8v.raw: 'You cannot Guard two turns in a row. A Guard is quick, too.'
1asdj8v.text: You cannot Guard two turns in a row. A Guard is quick, too.

02cwjvd.raw: 'Many moves have a kind. A small icon by the move shows it. Each kind has one rule.'
02cwjvd.text: Many moves have a kind. A small icon by the move shows it. Each kind has one rule.

0ailgte.raw: 'A dash rushes in. Till its next turn, the whorl takes 10% less damage. Guard does not stop a dash. A rooted whorl cannot dash.'
0ailgte.text: A dash rushes in. Till its next turn, the whorl takes 10% less damage. Guard does not stop a dash. A rooted whorl cannot dash.

0p093wg.raw: 'A projectile is thrown or shot. A whorl that guards takes only one quarter of it.'
0p093wg.text: A projectile is thrown or shot. A whorl that guards takes only one quarter of it.

1o7u82v.raw: 'A spell goes over walls that summons put up. A silenced whorl cannot cast a spell.'
1o7u82v.text: A spell goes over walls that summons put up. A silenced whorl cannot cast a spell.

0pcas92.raw: 'A channel keeps going on the next turns. Stun, Silence, Sleep, or a Switch stops it.'
0pcas92.text: A channel keeps going on the next turns. Stun, Silence, Sleep, or a Switch stops it.

1cj10qw.raw: 'Each whorl has two habits. A habit works by itself. You do not pick it. In a battle, press left or right on the menu to read the habits.'
1cj10qw.text: Each whorl has two habits. A habit works by itself. You do not pick it. In a battle, press left or right on the menu to read the habits.

147xbph.raw: 'A crest is a whorl\'s biggest move. Most whorls have one crest. A crest costs tide.'
147xbph.text: A crest is a whorl's biggest move. Most whorls have one crest. A crest costs tide.

1hnm0ky.raw: `Tide is a pool that your whole team shares. It holds up to ${NERVE_MAX}. It starts each battle at 2.`
1hnm0ky.text: Tide is a pool that your whole team shares. It holds up to {NERVE_MAX}. It starts each battle at 2.

1685alc.text: An Attack that lands adds 1 tide.

1yj3p8i.raw: 'When a move hits a whorl that guards, its side gets 1 tide. This works once for each Guard.'
1yj3p8i.text: When a move hits a whorl that guards, its side gets 1 tide. This works once for each Guard.

0f8zva8.raw: 'When you knock out a foe, you get 2 tide.'
0f8zva8.text: When you knock out a foe, you get 2 tide.

0ru6dmx.raw: 'When one of your whorls is knocked out, you get 1 tide.'
0ru6dmx.text: When one of your whorls is knocked out, you get 1 tide.

066qvt6.raw: 'Some moves, habits, and notions add tide too.'
066qvt6.text: Some moves, habits, and notions add tide too.

1ijkri7.raw: 'Here is an example. Cloudburst is Squall\'s crest. It costs 5 tide. You start with 2. Land 3 Attacks, and you have 5.'
1ijkri7.text: Here is an example. Cloudburst is Squall's crest. It costs 5 tide. You start with 2. Land 3 Attacks, and you have 5.

1pq8k3u.raw: 'The foe has its own pool of tide. Watch it. When it is full, a crest may come.'
1pq8k3u.text: The foe has its own pool of tide. Watch it. When it is full, a crest may come.

0pf1og7.raw: 'A crest has a cooldown too, like any other move.'
0pf1og7.text: A crest has a cooldown too, like any other move.

0c5u9tq.raw: 'Every whorl has one or two types. Every move has one type. Types decide who is strong against whom.'
0c5u9tq.text: Every whorl has one or two types. Every move has one type. Types decide who is strong against whom.

1dv0vtm.raw: 'There are six types. They are STONE, TIDE, ROOT, GEAR, BEAST, and STAR.'
1dv0vtm.text: There are six types. They are STONE, TIDE, ROOT, GEAR, BEAST, and STAR.

0zjsmee.raw: 'Each row is the type of a move. Each column is the type of the foe. A plus means the move is strong. A minus means it is weak.'
0zjsmee.text: Each row is the type of a move. Each column is the type of the foe. A plus means the move is strong. A minus means it is weak.

0qmfzxp.raw: 'A strong hit does 1.5 times the damage. A weak hit does about two thirds of it.'
0qmfzxp.text: A strong hit does 1.5 times the damage. A weak hit does about two thirds of it.

0cby41l.raw: 'Here is an example. TIDE is strong against STONE. Squall\'s Rain Shot hits Kivishi 1.5 times as hard. STONE is weak against TIDE. Kivishi\'s STONE moves do two thirds on Squall.'
0cby41l.text: Here is an example. TIDE is strong against STONE. Squall's Rain Shot hits Kivishi 1.5 times as hard. STONE is weak against TIDE. Kivishi's STONE moves do two thirds on Squall.

1s807y8.raw: 'A whorl with two types counts both. If both are weak to a move, it hits 2 times as hard. A strong one and a weak one cancel out. A hit never does more than 2 times, or less than half.'
1s807y8.text: A whorl with two types counts both. If both are weak to a move, it hits 2 times as hard. A strong one and a weak one cancel out. A hit never does more than 2 times, or less than half.

0vt0rpj.raw: 'When a hit lands, the battle shows strong or weak. Before you pick a move, look at it. It tells you when the foe is weak to it.'
0vt0rpj.text: When a hit lands, the battle shows strong or weak. Before you pick a move, look at it. It tells you when the foe is weak to it.

0o47oco.raw: 'A plain Attack has no type. Damage from statuses has no type either.'
0o47oco.text: A plain Attack has no type. Damage from statuses has no type either.

091bicn.raw: 'A status is a short effect on a whorl. It shows as a small icon by the whorl\'s HP bar.'
091bicn.text: A status is a short effect on a whorl. It shows as a small icon by the whorl's HP bar.

1e4dic6.raw: 'The number after a status is how many turns it lasts. Slow 2 lasts for 2 of the whorl\'s own turns. For Bleed and Poison, the number is how many stacks there are.'
1e4dic6.text: The number after a status is how many turns it lasts. Slow 2 lasts for 2 of the whorl's own turns. For Bleed and Poison, the number is how many stacks there are.

0rsroe7.raw: 'Stun. The whorl loses its next turn. A stun also cuts off a wind-up.'
0rsroe7.text: Stun. The whorl loses its next turn. A stun also cuts off a wind-up.

1m539a0.raw: 'Sleep. The whorl loses its turns. A hit wakes it up.'
1m539a0.text: Sleep. The whorl loses its turns. A hit wakes it up.

0gb7jwp.raw: 'Silence. The whorl cannot cast spells. Its other moves still work.'
0gb7jwp.text: Silence. The whorl cannot cast spells. Its other moves still work.

1j8jsw2.text: Taunt. The whorl can only Attack.

0fnktz0.raw: 'Root. The whorl cannot switch out or use a dash.'
0fnktz0.text: Root. The whorl cannot switch out or use a dash.

1u7pyc0.raw: 'Slow. Each of the whorl\'s next turns comes 30% of a turn later.'

1kcoe0z.text: Bleed. The whorl takes physical damage at the start of each turn. Then it loses one stack.

0ylzbw6.text: Doom. The whorl takes damage each turn. It cannot heal or use moves.

0blab62.text: Haste. Each of the whorl's next turns comes 30% of a turn sooner.

1w0o932.text: Empower. The whorl deals 25% more damage.

16f0pdb.text: Fortify. The whorl takes 25% less damage.

1ifmu9q.text: Regen. The whorl heals a little at the start of each turn.

0h3e0h2.text: Ward. It stops the next move a foe uses on the whorl. If nothing comes, it fades after 2 turns.

1tvcv88.text: Thorns. When the whorl is hit, it hits back for part of the damage.

0kfi86d.text: Untouchable. The whorl takes no damage. Another Untouchable does not make it last longer. The whorl is Seen through its next turn after Untouchable ends. Until then it cannot become Untouchable or Hidden.

0vdfbnr.text: Unstoppable. Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, Taunt, and Slow do not work on it.

0ycs6jg.text: Stasis. The whorl skips its turns. Nothing can hurt it or give it a status.

0izd5wz.text: Monument. The whorl cannot be knocked out. It stays at 1 HP.

0rowrfc.text: To learn what a mark does, read the habits of the whorl that makes it. In a battle, press left or right on the menu.

129i7qr.text: Some marks fade after a few turns. Some go away when the whorl switches out.

0q2jac1.text: Some moves call a helper onto the field. This helper is a summon. It stands by its whorl. It has a small HP bar under it.

0n3e3cd.text: A summon leaves when its HP runs out. Some leave after a set number of turns.

1l9z8mo.text: In a battle with a wild whorl, you can also pick Run. Run always works.

13zz9py.text: A notion is a small thing that a whorl holds. Each whorl can hold one notion.

1ciohiy.text: To give a notion, press X for the menu. Pick Team, then a whorl, then Give notion. Take notion puts it back in the Bag.

0oow8cr.text: Some notions have an action. The action is a choice in the battle menu. It works once each battle. It is quick, like a Switch.

1d7pkiv.text: To conjoin is to join two whorls into one new whorl. The Conjoiner does it at a grotto.

1sjneaw.text: Press V to sort a pocket by name, or by kind.
